correctness.rationale: The coefficient expansion (4) is exact, the uniform Gelfond estimate implies |T|<=CN^alpha by Abel, Parseval supplies integral |T|^2=1/(1-rho^2), and the proof bounds each ell=1..k error using the denominator geometry. The pure ell=k exponent 1+(k-2)alpha is below k-2 precisely when k>=7. Direct checker independently verified 2,568 exact finite coefficient identities; finite tests do not replace the infinite proof.
